system.description: Your genetic makeup is malleable, and shift and reconstitute itself to aid another. As a Bonus action, by touching a willing creature within your reach, you channel biomass into them. The target creature removes 1 rank of any Physical or Sensory condition they have while also regaining 1d6 + your level in hit points. You can use this effect once per creature, per rest. Beginning at 7th level, you can also remove 1 rank of a Mental condition, and increase the hit points regained by +1d6. Beginning at 15th level, increase the number of times you can use this on a creature to twice per rest.
